zh.text: 該國生產另一貨品會有絕對劣勢。

en.text: Suppose Mrs Wong, a sole proprietor of a garment factory, is the best cook in town, but she leaves all the cooking to her domestic helper at home. Which of the following would be correct?

zh.text: 假設王太是某家成衣廠的獨資擁有者，她的廚藝全城最佳，但她把家中的烹飪工作全都留給女傭去做。下列哪一項會是正確的？

en.text: The domestic helper has a comparative advantage in cooking.

zh.text: 該女傭在烹飪方面有比較優勢。

en.text: Both Mrs Wong and the domestic helper provide a labour service and receive wages.

zh.text: 王太與該女傭都提供勞力服務及獲取工資。

en.text: Complex division of labour is illustrated in this case.

zh.text: 該個案說明了複雜分工。

en.text: Both Mrs Wong and the domestic helper are tertiary producers.

zh.text: 王太與該女傭都是第三級生產者。

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2002 卷二 第 44 題

en.text: Consider the trade between two countries X and Y, both of which produce garments and computers only. If country X has the comparative advantage in producing garments, then country X

zh.text: 考慮 X、Y 兩國間的貿易，兩者只生產成衣及電腦兩種物品。若 X 國生產成衣有比較優勢，則 X 國

zh.text: 在兩國貿易中的賺獲較 Y 國的爲多。

en.text: Both countries A and B produce goods X and Y. Under which of the following conditions does country A have a comparative advantage in the production of X?

zh.text: 甲、乙兩國皆生產物品 X 及 Y。在下列哪一種情況下，甲國生產 X 享有比較優勢？

en.text: One unit of X can be exchanged for more units of Y in country A than in country B.

zh.text: 一單位 X 在甲國較在乙國可換得更多 Y。

en.text: In producing one unit of X, country A forgoes a smaller amount of Y than country B.

zh.text: 為了生產一單位 X，甲國較乙國放棄較少 Y。

en.text: The opportunity cost of producing X in country A is smaller than that of Y in country B.

zh.text: 甲國生產 X 的機會成本低於乙國生產 Y 的機會成本。

en.text: The amount of resources used in producing one unit of X is less in country A than in country B.

zh.text: 甲國生產一單位 X 所用的資源數量少於乙國。

en.text: The two countries have different opportunity costs of producing goods.

zh.text: 兩國生產貨品的機會成本不同。

en.text: Which of the following statements about international trade is correct if transportation cost increases?

zh.text: 若運輸費用增加，下列哪一項對國際貿易的描述是正確的？

en.text: The price of exported goods will increase if the exporting country has to bear the transportation costs.

zh.text: 若出口國要負擔運輸費，出口貨品的價格會增加。

en.text: The net gains from trade of the trading partners will remain unchanged as long as trade continues.

zh.text: 若貿易夥伴繼續通商，他們從貿易中獲得的淨收益會維持不變。

zh.text: 若運輸費用高於貿易總得益，比較優勢會消失。

en.text: Mutually beneficial trade is possible only if the transportation costs are lower than the total gains from trade.

zh.text: 只有當運輸費用低於貿易總得益，才有可能出現互利的貿易。

en.text: If Country X is more productive in producing every good than Country Y,

zh.text: 若 X 國在生產每種貨品上的生產力都比 Y 國高，

en.text: the gain from trade of Country X will be greater than that of Country Y.

zh.text: X 國的貿易得益將大於 Y 國。

en.text: mutually beneficial trade between the two countries is still possible.

zh.text: 兩國之間互惠互利的貿易仍然可能。

zh.text: Y 國將會從 X 國入口所有貨品，而非自行生產這些貨品。

en.text: Country X may have a lower opportunity cost in producing every good than Country Y.

zh.text: X 國在生產每種貨品上的機會成本可能比 Y 國低。
